Container.Name: USBCloud
Container.Overview: Manage USBCloud storage clients, archive recordings, and monitor device health. Includes the web dashboard, scheduler and transfer worker. Set Backend URL to the NAS address and mapped web port that your clients can reach. The management dashboard currently assumes a trusted local network.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Web dashboard and device heartbeat API.

Config.Name: App settings
Config.Description: Persistent settings, encryption key and SSH identity. Back up this directory.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: SQLite database and its journal files. Keep this directory across container updates.

Config.Name: Media clips
Config.Description: Persistent recordings, separate from application settings.

Config.Name: Backend URL
Config.Description: Required: full URL reachable from every client, for example http://192.168.1.10:8088. Use your HTTPS reverse proxy URL when available.
